label: PF Backlog 470
title: Docs: TOOLS-AND-DEPENDENCIES.md (PF tools, gaps like web_search, sourcing/keys/licensing/redistribution)
body:
Source: user request (2026-10-08) - list PF's tools + the ones we need, their purpose, sourcing
(API key / download / cloud / self-host) and licensing/redistribution implications, in one .md.

Add docs/TOOLS-AND-DEPENDENCIES.md covering: (1) the framework-agnostic tool layer (tool_registry + tool_policy +
tool_cache + agent_tool_loop + mcp + byot + plugins); (2) tools PF HAS (write_file/read_file/list_dir/run_command/
http_get; the run_command allow-list CLIs; adjacents git/ffmpeg/Playwright/docker); (3) tools NEEDED but missing
(web_search with pluggable backends, web_fetch/content extraction, document extraction, browser automation, local
code search, embeddings/vector, vision/ASR); (4) for each: purpose, why needed, where to get, API key?, license/
redistribution. (5) Redistribution principle: PF is MIT; do NOT bundle SaaS clients/keys - expose neutral
interfaces + adapters the user configures (self-host for zero-cost, or bring-your-own key); note AGPL (SearXNG),
ffmpeg LGPL/GPL, and cloud ToS. Not legal advice.

dashboard_impact: no UI surface.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/api_docs.py, core/licensing.py, core/workflow_docs.py, /api/v1/apidocs
